name: How long does a typical exterior house painting project take?
description: Exterior painting typically takes 3 days to 2 weeks, depending on house size, surface condition, and weather.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical exterior house painting project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior house painting project varies based on the size of the house, surface condition, weather, and complexity. A smaller house (1,000-1,500 sq ft) might take 3-5 days, while a larger or more complex home could take 1-2 weeks. This includes preparation (cleaning, scraping, priming), painting multiple coats, and drying time. Our team aims for efficiency without compromising quality, keeping you informed throughout the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior painting typically takes 3 days to 2 weeks, depending on house size, surface condition, and weather.
